notes: Command provenance: python qwen_inference.py --assets /root/autodl-tmp/c3-qwen3-4b-operator-goals/assets/Qwen3-4B/1cfa9a7208912126459214e8b04321603b3df60c --output /tmp/original-qwen (run from the repository root). Defaults apply: --workloads workloads.json, --warmup 2, --repeats 5, no --profile.

Workload row is copied unchanged from workloads.json qwen_inference.workloads[id='interactive'] with the section's prompt and correctness fields; the 'offline' (batch 8) and held_out 'long_prompt' rows are out of scope for this task per the user goal (batch 1, prompt 256, exactly 32 new greedy tokens).

The row's 'goals' list (ttft, decode_tokens_per_second) is provenance only: per the user, the primary objective end_to_end_ms covers the complete generation and ttft_ms is a constraint at <= 1.05 times this task's freshly measured ORIGINAL baseline TTFT. The constraint baseline is the evaluator's fresh measurement of the unmodified source in the same environment, not a constant recorded here.

Source-required task semantics: fixed 32-token greedy generation with EOS early stopping disabled by the explicit loop; per-step logits_to_keep=1 with the last-position logits used for argmax; KV cache created at prefill and threaded through all 31 decode steps, request-scoped (no state may leak across measured invocations); the explicit first-token and final torch.cuda.synchronize() boundaries define ttft_ms and end_to_end_ms (qwen_inference.py:16-40).

Numerical policies to preserve: BF16 weights (dtype=torch.bfloat16 at qwen_inference.py:49), SDPA attention (attn_implementation='sdpa'), TF32 disabled for matmul and cudnn, float32_matmul_precision('highest'), torch.manual_seed(20261020) (common.py:34-42).

Quality: full per-step last-position logits for all 32 generated positions compared with torch.testing.assert_close at atol=0.02, rtol=0.02 (workloads.json qwen_inference.correctness logits_atol/logits_rtol; check at qwen_inference.py:61), and the generated greedy token sequence is a discrete output requiring exact comparison (torch.equal at qwen_inference.py:62, require_exact_greedy_tokens). The reference is the unmodified source's own capture run with fixed-context teacher forcing (qwen_inference.py:59-60) plus a corrupted-output negative control (common.py:79-84); these checks and reference construction are measurement infrastructure, not work repeated by the measured invocation.

Baseline implementation choices (not frozen requirements): single .cuda() device placement, one process, greedy argmax sampling, teacher-forced reference capture, torch.profiler-based optional diagnostics. Semantics-equivalent implementations that keep the model, inputs, numerical policies, token outputs and both timing boundaries are acceptable; no multi-process or distributed execution is part of this workload (device_count=1 from the single-device .cuda() placement in the source).

Measured invocation statistics: the source records per-repeat metrics ttft_ms, decode_ms, end_to_end_ms, decode_tokens_per_second, generated_tokens_per_second and peak_allocated_bytes (qwen_inference.py:37-40,73-76) and reduces samples by median/min/max (common.py:66-71); only end_to_end_ms (objective) and ttft_ms (constraint) carry acceptance meaning for this task, and peak_allocated_bytes is informational.

All main timing excludes model loading, tokenization, host input transfer, correctness checks and profiling (README.md '计量与正确性' section); warmup=2 and repeats=5 are the harness's statistical warmup/repeats fields, kept out of the measured unit.

One measured invocation: One complete interactive generation unit, equal to a single infer(model, inputs, new_tokens=32) call in qwen_inference.py:14-41 on the fixed GPU-resident input tensor of shape (1, 256): prefill forward pass with use_cache=True and logits_to_keep=1, greedy argmax next-token selection from the last-position logits, torch.cuda.synchronize() at the explicit first-token-ready boundary, then exactly 31 cached decode steps (each a single-token forward with past_key_values, use_cache=True, logits_to_keep=1, argmax), with one KV cache living across the whole request, and the final torch.cuda.synchronize() completion boundary. The unit returns the 32 generated token ids; end_to_end_ms spans start (before prefill) to final synchronize and ttft_ms spans start to the first-token synchronize. Setup excluded from the measured unit: model/tokenizer loading, chat-template tokenization and prompt replication/truncation to 256 tokens, host-to-GPU input transfer, warmup iterations, statistical repeats, reference construction, correctness checks, result writing and profiling.

workload.prompt: Explain how a computer executes a neural network and why memory access, arithmetic and communication affect performance. Use concrete examples.

contract.completion: One measured invocation is one complete interactive generation unit, exactly a single infer(model, inputs, new_tokens=32) call (qwen_inference.py:14-41): prefill forward on the fixed GPU-resident input of shape (1, 256) with use_cache=True and logits_to_keep=1, greedy argmax of the last-position logits, torch.cuda.synchronize() at the explicit first-token-ready boundary (this ends ttft_ms), then exactly 31 single-token cached decode steps each threading past_key_values through one request-scoped KV cache, concatenation of the 32 generated token ids, and the final torch.cuda.synchronize() which ends end_to_end_ms. end_to_end_ms spans start (before prefill) to the final synchronize; ttft_ms spans start to the first-token synchronize; decode covers only the 31 post-first-token steps. EOS early stopping is disabled by the explicit fixed-length loop. Model/tokenizer loading, chat-template tokenization, prompt replication/truncation, host-to-GPU input transfer, warmup, statistical repeats, reference construction, correctness checks and profiling are all outside the measured unit.
invariants: Workload is exactly the frozen 'interactive' row from request['workload'] (batch=1, prompt_tokens=256, new_tokens=32); the 'offline' batch-8 row and the held-out 'long_prompt' row in workloads.json are out of scope for this task (request.json notes; the adapter must read these dimensions from the request).

Exactly 32 new tokens are generated; generation is greedy argmax sampling and EOS early stopping is disabled by the explicit fixed-length loop (qwen_inference.py:25-33; README '计量与正确性'). The full declared token count must be produced even though the objective could tempt shorter work.
Next-token selection at every step is argmax over the last-position logits of a forward called with logits_to_keep=1 (qwen_inference.py:18-19, 27-29).

Prefill creates the KV cache with use_cache=True and all 31 decode steps are single-token forwards threading past_key_values from the previous step; exactly one KV cache lives across the request and it is request-scoped, so no state may leak across measured invocations (qwen_inference.py:18, 22, 27-28; request note on state lifetimes).

Inputs are unchanged: the local Qwen3-4B assets from request['assets'], the fixed prompt string from the workload, chat-template tokenization with add_generation_prompt=True and enable_thinking=False, then replication/truncation to exactly 256 tokens as a GPU-resident int64 tensor of shape (1, 256) (qwen_inference.py:48, 55-58).

Numerical policies are frozen: BF16 weights (dtype=torch.bfloat16), SDPA attention (attn_implementation='sdpa'), TF32 disabled for matmul and cudnn, cudnn.benchmark=False, float32_matmul_precision('highest'), torch.manual_seed(20261020) (qwen_inference.py:49; common.py:34-42).

Correctness is reference fidelity at the source thresholds: full per-step last-position logits for all 32 generated positions compared with torch.testing.assert_close at atol=0.02, rtol=0.02, plus exact equality of the 32 greedy token ids; a fixed-context teacher-forced replay must reproduce the free-run greedy tokens exactly (torch.equal) and its captured logits within tolerance (qwen_inference.py:59-64; workloads.json qwen_inference.correctness, require_exact_greedy_tokens).

Both completion synchronization boundaries stay inside the timed invocation with their source meaning: the explicit first-token-ready torch.cuda.synchronize() defines the ttft_ms boundary and the final torch.cuda.synchronize() defines end_to_end_ms; ttft_ms spans start to the first boundary, end_to_end_ms spans start to the final boundary, decode_tokens_per_second counts only the 31 decode tokens over the decode phase (qwen_inference.py:16-40).

Timing excludes model/tokenizer loading, tokenization, host input transfer, warmup iterations, statistical repeats, reference construction, correctness checks and profiling; the measured unit is one infer() call on the fixed GPU-resident input (README '计量与正确性'; request note on the measured invocation).

The objective end_to_end_ms is minimized over the complete generation while ttft_ms <= 1.05 times this task's freshly measured ORIGINAL baseline TTFT in the same environment; the constraint baseline is the evaluator's fresh measurement of the unmodified source, not a constant recorded in the request (request.json goal/objective/notes). The full 32-token workload is kept even though the constraint measures only the first phase.

No multi-process or distributed execution is part of this workload: one process, one device (request.json note; the source uses a single .cuda() placement, device_count=1), so no communication collectives are required or fabricated.
contract.state_protocol: prepare(context, request) runs outside timing: it loads the Qwen3-4B tokenizer and BF16 SDPA model from request['assets']['qwen3_4b_weights'] onto context['device'], applies the source numerical policies and seed from common.configure (torch.set_num_threads(4), interop threads 1, torch.manual_seed(20261020), TF32 disabled for matmul and cudnn, cudnn.benchmark=False, float32_matmul_precision('highest')), builds the chat-templated prompt (enable_thinking=False) replicated/truncated to workload['prompt_tokens'] as a GPU-resident int64 tensor of shape (workload['batch'], prompt_tokens), and keeps model/inputs/dimensions in state. Workload dimensions (batch, prompt_tokens, new_tokens) are read from request['workload'], never embedded as constants. reset(state) runs outside timing and only re-establishes the starting point (eval mode, seed): generation is stateless greedy inference and each run() creates its own request-scoped KV cache (no past_key_values is passed in), so no cache, generator, counter or optimizer state can leak across measured invocations and none needs restoration. set_mode(state, mode) toggles the source's capture flag outside timing: 'quality' retains the full per-step last-position logits inside run() (the source's correctness-capture path), 'measure'/'profile' keep the source's clean no-capture timing path; execution semantics and the full work amount are identical in every mode. observe() collects tokens and (in quality mode) full logits plus the source's teacher-forced relational replay check, outside the timer. metrics() queries CUDA peak statistics outside the timer, after the framework's peak-stat reset and timer boundaries.

code_review.mapping: observe generated_tokens is run tokens.detach, and step_logits is run full stacked logits.detach. Both come from the full original infer mirror, not a reduced/renormalized output.
code_review.complete_work: One prefill plus31cached single-token forwards, fixed32token greedy output, logits_to_keep1, no EOS early exit. Teacher-forced32step replay is in observe outside measurement, as source correctness work.
code_review.timers: Original sync before start, first-token sync, final sync retained. The framework also brackets run; primary and TTFT use the adapter internal source clocks. Phase annotations add instrumentation and are not assumed zero-cost.
code_review.owners: prepare owns model, tokenizer, inputs and CPU dimensions/metadata; no prepared CUDA reference logits or cache owner in this adapter. _infer locals own output/cache until return; quality result owns full logits/tokens, clean result tokens/CPUmetrics. Invocation lifetime clears last quality result before warmup and releases each clean result after metrics before next invocation. No model/cache global owner introduced in reviewed code.
code_review.memory_limits: Source clean assignment discards returned tokens before peak query; framework keeps current tokens (32int64 values, allocator rounding not separately measured) through metrics then releases. Both computation peaks include tokens. Framework allocated/lifecycle fields are not numerically identical source metrics, and lifecycle includes quality/prepare history; no cross-adapter memory gain inferred.
code_review.math: Source BF16/SDPA, TF32off/highest, seed and prompt construction preserved. requires_gradFalse differs from original parameter flags but run is inference_mode in both; no source gradient workload exists here.
code_review.contract: New completion text correctly calls first boundary ttft_ms and complete generation end_to_end_ms; old variant stale prose is not inherited. Source one-device workload preserved.
code_review.next: Only external reviewed mapping is needed. No production prompt/adapter/request edits. Compare full existing controls to independent source in a recorded CPU worker, then continue unstarted search with shared read-only controls.
code_review.limits: This is manual source review plus controls, not independent numerical source pass yet. Tool input path audit is not exhaustive external filesystem isolation.
